_meta.purpose: Year-by-year conditions for the 2020-2025 check, as multipliers on the calibrated 2025 year.

sources.hotel_occupancy: Niagara Falls hotel occupancy: 2019 65%, 2020 28%, 2021 34%, 2022 55% (data/sim_parameters.json, regional hotel market); 2023 about 68% and 2024 about 66% (CBRE year-to-date, data/hotel_monthly_cbre.json); 2025 about 62% (CBRE January-November 63.2%, full year a little lower).
sources.us_arrivals: US travellers into Ontario: 13.16M (2019), 11.31M (2024), 10.79M (2025) (data/behaviour_parameters.json). The border was closed to US leisure travel from March 2020 to August 2021; 2022 and 2023 values are interpolated (SEED).
sources.residents: Residents spent less in 2020 and 2021 while dine-in and non-essential retail were closed (SEED).

_meta.method: visitors overall move with hotel occupancy relative to 2025; US and overseas are set from arrival data and the border closure; domestic visitors make up the rest so total visitor demand moves with occupancy.
